guitar.modelsText: Fender Jazzmaster / Gibson Les Paul / Gretsch
guitar.notes: Turner has used Jazzmasters, Gibson ES-335/Les Pauls, and various others over the band's career; no single iconic instrument, so medium confidence is appropriate.

tone.target: moody edge-of-breakup indie clean with delay-washed depth
tone.profile: moody edge-of-breakup indie clean with delay-washed depth
tone.summary: A moody indie chain using light compression, a low-gain British amp model (UK 45/SLP), and heavy modulation/delay for depth.

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain tight rhythm.
Smooth dynamics and add sustain for the moody depth.
Provide the required 'edge-of-breakup' light grit without high crunch.
Simulate the classic British 'Vox/Marshall edge' and dark tone.
Provide a classic British voicing that complements the UK SLP amp model.
Darken the overall tone and reduce excessive brightness/crunch.
Add subtle movement and 'washed depth' to the clean parts.
Create the required 'wide delay space' and moody echo effect.
Add subtle natural room depth without muddying the rhythm.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for a darker, more natural British indie tone.

proposals.reason: The current 'UK Vintage 4x12' might be too bright; a darker, more vintage-voiced cab will enhance the moody depth.
proposals.expectedGain: Darker, rounder low end and less harsh high frequencies.
